item.title: Major League DJz call for South African spinning star Sam Sam to join the next 'Fast and Furious' film
item.description: Major League DJz want South African spinning star Sam Sam to take his skills from the streets to the 'Fast & Furious' big screen.

item.title: Newcastle Municipality secures equitable share allocation from National Treasury
item.description: Newcastle Municipality municipal manager Zamani Mcineka said the municipality received the equitable share funds on December 18.

item.title: COSATU raises alarm over potential closure of Mozal, threatens 27,200 jobs in South Africa and Mozambique
item.description: South32 said that although it had continued to engage with the Mozambican government, power supplier Hidroeléctrica de Cahora Bassa (HCB) and Eskom to seek sufficient and affordable electricity supply for Mozal beyond March 2026, it had not managed to reach an agreement.

item.title: Where are they now? Revisiting Bafana Bafana’s 2010 World Cup squad 15 years on
item.description: Bafana Bafana's 2010 World Cup squad pose for a photograph with president Jacob Zuma ahead of their opening match against Mexico at Soccer City Stadium in Johannesburg. Photo: Alexander Joe/AFP

item.title: Five killed after Mexican navy plane crashes off Texas Coast during medical mission
item.description: At least five people were killed after a Mexican Navy aircraft crashed in waters off the US state of Texas while carrying out a medical transfer, the navy said Monday.

item.title: Minister Firoz Cachalia to lead festive season policing oversight in KwaZulu-Natal
item.description: Acting Police Minister Firoz Cachalia will oversee festive season safety operations in KwaZulu-Natal, visiting malls and hotspots, accompanied by top SAPS officials and hosted by the provincial commissioner.

item.title: Final call for ‘The Shady Lurker’: DJ Warras to be laid to rest amid breakthrough in murder case
item.description: The family and friends of Warrick “DJ Warras” Stock are gathering in Rosebank for a private funeral service.

item.title: British singer Chris Rea, best known for ‘Driving Home for Christmas’, dies aged 74
item.description: British singer Chris Rea, best known for the 1980s festive hit &quot;Driving Home For Christmas&quot;, has died at the age of 74, a family spokesperson told UK media on December 22, 2025.

item.title: Chicken Licken unveils original anthem celebrating South Africa's gift to the world
item.description: Chicken Licken launches a heartfelt anthem celebrating SA's culture and generosity.

item.title: Johannesburg protest calls for justice for hunger striking political prisoners
item.description: A ‘Free the Political Prisoners’ solidarity protest will be held on Tuesday, 23 December 2025 at the offices of the British Council.
